content.short: Voteaire is an easy-to-use on-chain voting platform. Enabling SPOs and organisations to conduct voting for their respective communities.
content.description:
Voteaire is an easy to use platform that allows anyone to create an on-chain vote in the Cardano ecosystem. All ballots and votes are stored publicly on-chain for verifiability, and the data specification has been published in an open source repository for everyone to see.

Our focus is on usability, and on building something that non-technical users can use to create ballots, or to vote just by connecting their wallet and submitting a transaction.

The initial launch will be released with three different voting types:

This tool will have a far-reaching impact on the Cardano community. Projects such as DAOs, NFT projects, and utility-token projects will now be free to poll their community holders with a true, on-chain weighted vote instead of needing to rely on third party centralised solutions like Discord. Stake pool operators will also be able to poll their delegators to make decisions about the direction of their pool, such as changing the fees, or creating additional pools. This is just the beginning.
